NORTHFOLD
Start your brand

Brands with a point of view and the looks to match.

Northfold is a branding studio in Copenhagen. We create names, logos, packaging and brand guidelines for food, beauty and lifestyle companies that want to be noticed and remembered.

See brand projectsView packages
About the studio

A good brand makes the choice easy.

Customers decide in seconds. We make sure that when they see your pack on the shelf or your logo on a screen, they know what you stand for and why you're worth it.

Founded in 2011, we're a team of eleven strategists, designers and writers. We take on around twelve brand projects a year, so every client gets our full attention.

Services

What we make for you.

Brand strategy

Research into your customers and competitors, then a clear positioning, promise and personality your whole team can use.

Workshops, positioning statement, brand story

Naming

Names that are easy to say, easy to remember and available as a domain and trademark in your key markets.

Name shortlist, trademark checks, domain search

Visual identity

Logo, colours, typefaces, photography style and all the small details that make a brand feel consistent.

Logo suite, colour system, type, icons

Packaging

Packs designed to stand out on shelf and online, prepared properly for printers and factories.

Structure, labels, print-ready files

Brand guidelines

A simple guide your team, printers and agencies can follow, so the brand looks right everywhere.

Digital guidelines, templates, asset library
What you receive

A complete brand kit, ready to use.

This is part of the kit we made for Tove & Oak, an organic skincare brand. Every client gets the same level of detail.

From first meeting to launch in 12 weeks.

Weeks 1 to 3

Interviews with your team and customers, plus a close look at your competitors.

FAQ

Questions about branding.

How much does branding cost?

A logo and visual identity with us starts at €9,500. A full brand with strategy, packaging and guidelines is usually €22,000. Larger rebrands start at €35,000.

How long does a branding project take?

Six weeks for an identity package and around twelve weeks for a full brand with packaging.

What's the difference between a logo and a brand?

A logo is one part of a brand. A brand also includes your name, colours, typefaces, tone of voice, photography style and packaging, all working together.

Do we own the final designs?

Yes. When the final invoice is paid, you own full rights to the logo and all designs we create for you.

Contact

Let's build your brand.

We take on a few new projects each season. Tell us about yours and we'll reply within two working days.

# Branding Studio

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/branding-studio/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
